title: Axon Quote Q-865809 revision history and Council scheduling of the Axon amendment (File 26-11633)
summary:
Concerns Axon Quote Q-865809-009, Attachment 1 to the 2026-10-05 agenda report for Amendment No. 1 to the City's Master Services and Purchasing Agreement with Axon Enterprise, Inc. (File 26-11633). The attached quote is labeled revision 009, shows an issue date of 2026-09-05, and shows an expiration date of 2026-10-16.

- Item 1: each earlier revision of Q-865809 the City received (Q-865809-001 through -008 and any other revision), in the form received, showing each revision's issue and expiration dates,
- Item 2: any other Axon quote or proposal for Outpost or other ALPR cameras the Police Department received between 2025-01-01 and 2026-10-05, under any quote number,
- Item 3: records showing when the Axon amendment item (File 26-11633) was submitted for a Council agenda and when it was scheduled for the 2026-10-05 meeting, such as the agenda item request, routing or approval entries.

policy_promises.quote: agency must notify requester within 10 calendar days whether it will produce records
policy_promises.tests: Does the City issue a determination by 2026-10-16?

prior_pra_refs.note: Same-day companion: City–Axon and internal communications containing "Q-865809" or "Outpost", 2026-01-01 through 2026-10-05.
Same-day companion: audits and audit trail for the Department's existing Axon Fleet 3 ALPR platform.

filed_because: Council approved Amendment No. 1 to the Axon MSPA on 2026-10-05, adding Quote Q-865809-009 as Exhibit D. The quote in the packet is the ninth revision. The request asks for the earlier revisions and any other Axon ALPR quotes, plus the records showing when the item was submitted and scheduled for the 2026-10-05 agenda.
notes:
Filed 2026-10-06; auto-acknowledged the same day at 11:19 AM and forwarded to department(s) for processing. Statutory determination due 2026-10-16.

Closed 2026-10-16, on the statutory date (Kelly O'Keefe, Police Technical Services Administrator). The two-page legal-review letter answers each item "Responsive records available on GovQA." and cites no exemption.

Item 1: three revisions produced, Q-865809-003, -008 and -009. Revisions -001, -002 and -004 through -007 were not produced, and the letter does not say whether the City received them. The Chief is the primary contact on each.
- -003 (issued 2026-07-20, expires 2026-09-29): 59 Outpost sites (60 cameras), all shipping 2026-09-15, before the Council vote; 54 TAP plus 5 donor/extension; 99 months, 2026-10-15 to 2035-01-14; net $1,137,974.48, total $1,169,541.00; payments from 2028-06-01.
- -008 (issued 2026-08-25, expires 2026-09-29): restructured to 45 sites (46 cameras: 40 TAP + 5 donor + 1 spare) shipping 2026-10-15, plus 14 more shipping 2027-10-15; 98 months from 2026-11-15; net $1,112,613.70, total $1,145,260.45. These are the terms Council approved.
- -009 (issued 2026-09-05, expires 2026-10-16): text identical to -008 except the quote number, issue/expiry dates and Doc ID, i.e. a re-issue that moved the expiration from before the 2026-10-05 meeting to after it.

Item 2: Q-841238-46129TS (issued 2026-04-17, expires 2026-06-19, estimated contract start 2026-08-15). It has the same 54 Outpost TAP and 5 donor cameras plus 12 Axon Lightpost PTZ units ("Axon Lightpost - Advanced 3P Camera", Lightpost Core, "UbiHub 2.0 with Axon embedded capability (Core/AI)"), all hardware shipping 2026-07-15; 101 months. Subtotals: Outpost $1,137,974.46, Lightpost $494,835.36; total $1,645,727.28 with tax. No Q-865809 revision produced includes Lightpost. PDF metadata: created 2026-01-30 09:44 PST (Conga PDF Engine), modified 2026-04-17 08:29 PDT.

Expiration history across the four produced quotes: 2026-06-19 (Q-841238, issued 04-17), then 2026-09-29 (-003, issued 07-20), 2026-09-29 (-008, issued 08-25) and 2026-10-16 (-009, issued 09-05). The April quote lapsed on 06-19, and Axon issued a new quote with the same Outpost subtotal about a month later. The 09-29 expiration was then extended to 10-16 before it arrived. -009 changes only the dates on -008, so that extension added 17 days with no change in terms. Other dates slid with each re-issue: estimated contract start 2026-08-15, then 10-15, then 11-15; first shipment 2026-07-15, then 09-15, then 10-15. The first payment stayed in June 2028 in all four quotes, and the Outpost TAP subtotal changed by only $0.02 between Q-841238 and -003. No quote has terms making the expiration binding or saying what happens to pricing after it; the only "subject to change" language concerns tax. The six unproduced revisions (-001, -002, -004 to -007) may show further moves.

Item 3: a one-page Master Agenda Workflow report (pdfmake, generated 2026-10-07 09:56 PDT). The item was created and added to a meeting 2026-08-31 09:28, six days after -008 was issued.
- Originator Review 08-31 to 09-17 (-009 was issued 09-05, during this step).
- City Attorney Review 09-17 to 09-21, Originator Review 09-21 to 09-22, City Attorney Review 09-22 (completed by a different attorney than the assignee).
- City Clerk 09-22 to 09-24, City Manager 09-24 to 09-30 12:38, City Clerk to "Approve On Agenda" 2026-09-30 18:37.
- Rows for Peer Review, Department Head Review and Assistant City Manager Review have no assignee or dates. The report does not show which meeting the item was first added to.

PDF metadata: each Q-865809 PDF was created on its issue date (PDFKit), and all three were modified 2026-10-07 10:19–10:31 PDT.
